laws: Durable index and artifact records are exact-schema validated before any path or mutation authority is derived.
Checkpoint and quarantine identifiers are sequence-bound and every artifact path is canonical, contained, regular and no-follow.
Migration and restore publish only after the history sink is preflighted and compensate exact prior project bytes when acknowledgement fails.
Quarantine and garbage collection restore exact prior index and artifact bytes when durable history acknowledgement fails.
Garbage collection prevalidates every indexed checkpoint digest and byte count before deleting any retained artifact.
Ambiguous post-publication history failure is typed as durability indeterminate rather than converted to success.

outcomeMatrix.outcome: core forward migration, checkpoint history and manual restore
strict durable index schema, sequence binding, path containment and no-follow artifact validation
history preflight and project, restore, quarantine and GC acknowledgement compensation
production composition-root integration, live user-data migration and cross-process serialization

residualRisks: The certified profile uses synthetic temporary filesystem fixtures and does not execute a live user-data migration.
The module is process-local and does not claim cross-process or cross-host serialization.
A history save that may have committed before surfacing an error is reported as typed durability indeterminate.
No production composition-root attachment, user document mutation, storage adoption, dependency, SAFE_APPLY, release, signing, cloud or AI authority is added.
